title: Dimensional Rift
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji used the Tianji Record to deduce the weakness of the dimensional invaders, but the cost was consuming ten years of his lifespan—this battle, he had no retreat.

text.content: Above the imperial capital, the jet-black rift like a demonic eye opened by the heavens swallowed the last glow of sunset. Chen Ji stood on the highest Star-Picking Pavilion of the imperial palace, gazing at the wound tearing apart heaven and earth, his pupils reflecting a silhouette that would drive mortals to despair—a form of existence beyond the comprehension of the Three Realms, like a distorted giant woven from countless twisted rays of light, each edge emanating a chill that made souls tremble.

"The Observer... has finally appeared?" The twisted existence uttered a whisper like ten thousand ghosts wailing in unison, the voice not emerging from a mouth but directly resonating in the mental sea of everyone present. Chen Ji felt an ancient and vast pressure more powerful than the Heavenly Dao's Eye descend upon him, and the Tianji Record fragment in his sleeve suddenly burned scalding hot, as if issuing some warning.

dialogue.content: A faint, indifferent smile curved Chen Ji's lips, his voice not loud but clearly piercing through that suffocating pressure: "Distinguished guests from beyond the Three Realms, descending to the mortal realm without even a greeting, yet you ask the hosts? Is this the etiquette of dimensional invaders?" His tone carried undisguised mockery, and facing that existence capable of crushing the heavens, he showed not a trace of fear.

text.content: The twisted giant swayed slightly, as if examining an ant attempting to shake a tree. Several jet-black rays detached from its form, spreading toward the imperial capital like vines, and where they touched structures, those pavilions and towers vanished like erased ink marks, instantly disappearing into void. The wails of the capital's citizens rose and fell, yet were quickly devoured by that eerie silence.

The Tianji Record fragment in Chen Ji's sleeve flew out abruptly, spreading before him into a complete golden scroll—that was a complete form he had never revealed before. The voice of Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul condensed in his mental sea: "Boy, this battle you cannot avoid. The first complete activation of the Tianji Record's full version will consume fifty years of your Heavenly Fate—but this is also your only chance to glimpse their true nature."

dialogue.content: The twisted giant spoke slowly, its voice carrying a coldness beyond good and evil: "Observers should not exist in the Three Realms. You are an error, a deviation from order. Today, we shall correct this error." With its words, more and more distorted existences poured from that rift, spreading toward every direction of the capital like locusts.

text.content: Golden light swirled in Chen Ji's eyes as the complete Tianji Record operated at full power. He saw—in three breaths' time, the twisted giant would launch a dimensional strike capable of erasing half the capital; he saw countless citizens turning to nothing in despair; he saw that if he did not intervene, the three great sects would all be destroyed within three days.

dialogue.content: "Error?" Chen Ji suddenly burst into laughter, that laughter echoing above the imperial capital, carrying a flavor of madness intertwined with clarity. He raised his hand, and the Tianji Record fragment transformed into a虚幻 sword grasped in his palm: "The countless beings of the Three Realms, flourishing for hundreds of millions of years, are merely 'errors' needing to be 'corrected' in your eyes?" His tone suddenly turned cold, "Then today, let me see who truly is the error."

choice.prompt: The power displayed by the dimensional invaders far exceeded imagination, Chen Ji had to make a choice:

choices.text: Fight to the death without retreat
choices.description: Use the Observer's power to confront the dimensional invaders directly, bet everything to intercept the dimensional strike, protect the billions of living souls in the capital
choices.visible_cost: Consume fifty years of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Successfully intercept the dimensional strike, obtain intelligence on the nature of dimensional invaders
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate will drop to dangerous levels, greatly reducing combat capability in subsequent battles

text.content: Before Chen Ji's words finished, his form had already turned into a stream of light rushing toward the twisted giant. Every inch of his skin was enduring the agony of dimensional tearing, and the power of the complete Tianji Record burned frantically within him. He knew he had chosen the most foolish path—but behind him were billions of innocent citizens, he had no choice.

dialogue.content: The twisted giant tilted its head slightly, as if for the first time seriously examining this ant that dared to resist: "Interesting... courage born within error. But courage cannot change destined fate." It extended a finger woven from countless rays of light, pointing remotely at Chen Ji.

text.content: Chen Ji felt an irresistible force lock onto him, a dimensional suppression beyond the laws of the Three Realms. Yet he did not retreat; instead, he bit through his tongue and sprayed a mouthful of essence blood onto the sword formed from the Tianji Record. The blade suddenly erupted with dazzling golden light, colliding thunderously with the dimensional power of the twisted giant.

choices.description: Preserve strength, bring intelligence on the dimensional invaders back to the three great sects, unite all forces before the final battle
choices.visible_cost: The capital suffers heavy losses, reputation declines
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Heavenly Fate, gain strategic buffer time
choices.risk_hint: Bear enormous public pressure and moral condemnation

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes sharpened, and the Tianji Record operated once more. He saw a longer future line—if he fights to the death now, perhaps he could intercept this attack, but within three days he would die from exhaustion of Heavenly Fate, and then the dimensional invaders would devour the entire Three Realms without any obstruction.

dialogue.content: "Retreat!" Chen Ji roared abruptly, his voice carrying unwavering resolve. His figure surged backward as a golden light shot from his sleeve, transforming into a massive barrier suspended above the imperial capital, buying precious time for the citizens to flee. "Today's grudge, I Chen Ji shall remember." His voice echoed through the air, laden with deep-seated hatred.

text.content: The twisted giant let out a low, guttural laugh: "Fleeing, are we, Observer? Your choice was wise—but merely delayed the time of correction." With a gentle flick of its finger, the barrier shattered instantly. The eastern district of the imperial capital dissolved into nothingness, countless lives vanishing amid agonized screams.

choices.description: Using the Tianji Record as a medium, forcibly connect to the protective mountain formations of the three great sects, borrowing the power of heaven and earth to resist the dimensional invasion
choices.visible_cost: Expose the existence of the complete Tianji Record, drawing covetous attention from various forces
choices.visible_reward: Gain the blessing of the combined power from the three great sects
choices.risk_hint: Will completely expose one's strength, limiting subsequent scheming and layout

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forming complex hand seals with both hands. The Tianji Record transformed into a pillar of light shooting toward the heavens, piercing through the dimensional rift's blockade, shooting directly toward the three great sects. He was gambling—betting that those cunning old foxes would understand the meaning behind this pillar of light.

dialogue.content: "Everyone, in this crisis of the Three Realms' survival, I implore you to act!" Chen Ji's voice traveled to every corner of the Three Realms along with that pillar of light. Simultaneously, the protective formations of the Tianqing Sect, Xuanwu Sect, and Vermilion Bird Sect all illuminated. Three brilliant rays of light surged toward the heavens, slamming into that dimensional rift.

text.content: The twisted giant's form trembled slightly, for the first time revealing a hint of solemnity: "Interesting... Ants from a lower dimension, yet capable of borrowing the power of heaven and earth." It extended countless light rays woven into a massive palm, confronting those three brilliant attacks. In a deafening roar, the dimensional rift was actually shaken—just slightly.

The battle entered its white-hot phase. Chen Ji's figure darted around the twisted giant, each appearance accompanied by a golden sword light. His attacks seemed chaotic and disorganized, but in truth, every sword precisely struck those nodes where light rays intersected—those were the weak points of the dimensional invaders deduced by the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: "You can actually perceive our essence?" For the first time, a tremor appeared in the twisted giant's voice, carrying disbelief: "The power of an Observer... No, you are no ordinary observer! You are..." Its words cut off abruptly, as if touching upon some forbidden topic.

Chen Ji let out a cold laugh as his sword stance shifted abruptly: "Who I am is none of your concern, distinguished guest. But as for you—since you claim we are an error, then today let me show you—just what this 'error' can accomplish!" The Heavenly Fate remaining within his body burned furiously, transforming into brilliant golden light that enveloped his entire form.

choice.prompt: At this critical juncture of battle, Chen Ji must make a decision:

choices.description: Burn all Heavenly Fate Value, launch an attack beyond all limits, directly targeting the core of the dimensional invaders
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate Value drops to zero, possible instant death
choices.visible_reward: If successful, will severely damage the core of the dimensional invaders

text.content: A gleam of absolute resolve flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. He spread his arms wide as the Tianji Record transformed into countless golden threads wrapping around his body. He could feel his life force draining rapidly, but he didn't care—because he saw it, in the core where countless twisted rays of light intertwined, there was a faint glimmer of light.

That was the core of the dimensional invaders—and also their sole weakness. Chen Ji's form erupted upward, transforming into a golden meteor piercing through heaven and earth, shooting directly toward that glimmer of light. The twisted giant let out a furious roar: "You dare!" Countless light rays wove into a barrier, attempting to intercept.

choices.description: Utilize the weakness information deduced by the Tianji Record, strike precisely while preserving strength, seeking a superior opportunity for battle
choices.visible_cost: Battle duration extends, imperial capital losses intensify
choices.visible_reward: Discover more weaknesses of the dimensional invaders, accumulating intelligence for the subsequent decisive battle
choices.risk_hint: risk of being exposed to the enemy

text.content: Chen Ji did not choose to go all-in. Instead, relying on the Tianji Record's calculations, he constantly shifted positions, each sword thrust precisely striking those faint weaknesses. His movements seemed chaotic, but actually contained a certain rhythm—he was laying out his subsequent attacks.

dialogue.content: "You're stalling for time!" The twisted giant suddenly realized, its voice filled with rage. "Do you think finding our weaknesses can change anything? How naive!" It suddenly expanded, and the dimensional rift expanded as well, with more distorted beings pouring out from it.

text.content: Chen Ji's lips curved into a cold smile: "I don't need to change anything. I just need you to know—the Three Realms may be weak, but we are not lambs waiting to be slaughtered." The Tianji Record sword in his hand suddenly emitted a clear chime, and a golden rune shot into the sky.

choices.text: luring the enemy into a trap
choices.description: lure the dimensional invaders to the imperial forbidden grounds, using the ancient seal formations to combat dimensional beings
choices.visible_cost: the imperial forbidden grounds may be destroyed, potentially harming innocents
choices.visible_reward: using the seal formations' power may severely wound the dimensional invaders
choices.risk_hint: risk of being counterattacked by the seal formations

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly turned around and raced toward the depths of the imperial capital. His figure left an afterimage in the air as the twisted giant pursued relentlessly behind him. "Think you can escape?" its voice carried mockery. "Against dimensions, any escape is futile."

Chen Ji gave no response, only flying toward the imperial forbidden grounds—the temple sealing the remnant body of an ancient deity. He knew what was sealed there, and he knew that thing held natural suppression over dimensional beings—this was his true trump card.

When the twisted giant chased him to the temple's airspace, it suddenly halted. "This is..." for the first time, fear appeared in its voice. "A remnant body of a low-dimensional deity? Impossible! How could you possibly seal..." Before it finished speaking, a brilliant divine light erupted from the temple.

The collision between the dimensional rift and the divine light of the imperial forbidden grounds unleashed a shockwave capable of tearing apart the heavens. Chen Ji was blasted backward by that force, blood spraying from his lips. Yet his eyes burned with excitement—because he saw the twisted giant's form distort and disintegrate within the divine light.

dialogue.content: "Excellent... you've successfully enraged us." The twisted giant's voice emerged from the disintegration, carrying a strange calm. "But you think this can stop the correction? How laughable... dimensions won't halt their steps just because one projection is lost. The next wave of invasion will descend in one month.届时..." Its form completely vanished, but those unfinished words pierced Chen Ji's heart like ice.

text.content: The dimensional rift slowly closed, and the darkness above the imperial capital finally dispersed. Yet what lay before Chen Ji was a living hell—half the capital reduced to nothingness, ruins and corpses everywhere, survivors' wails echoing through the clouds. He floated silently in the air, gazing at all this, his eyes holding no anger, only cold calculation.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted from his sleeve, sighing: "Boy, did you see it? This is the terrifying aspect of dimensional invaders. They don't come to conquer—they come to 'correct'—erasing all existence that doesn't conform to their order." His voice carried a certain deep忧虑: "And you are the greatest 'error' in their eyes."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly descended, stepping on the rubble-covered ruins. He raised his head toward the healed sky, a cold smile curling his lips: "Error?" His voice was soft, yet carried an unwavering force. "Since we're errors, then let this error—drag all you self-proclaimed 'correct' existences into the abyss."

text.content: Just then, a familiar figure landed beside Chen Ji—it was Su Qingyao. Her garments were stained with blood, clearly she too had endured a brutal battle. Gazing at the ruins before her, her eyes were filled with shock and heartache, then she turned to Chen Ji: "Chen Ji... what happened? What were those things...?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji turned to face Su Qingyao, his usually calm eyes now burning with some fierce light: "Beings from beyond the Three Realms have descended." He paused, his voice low. "They say we're errors, that they will correct us. And the future I can see—in one month, a larger-scale invasion will descend.届时..." He didn't finish, but that unspoken words were heavy enough.

text.content: Su Qingyao was silent for a moment, then stepped forward and took Chen Ji's cold fingers in her hand: "Whatever it is, we face it together." Her voice was soft, yet carried undeniable resolve. Chen Ji lowered his gaze to their intertwined hands, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes.

Chen Ji gave no answer, only gently squeezed her hand in return. In this moment, he did not calculate, did not strategize—merely a mortal bearing too much weight, seeking a brief moment of respite in a companion's warmth. Yet he knew this peace would not last—the true war would only begin in one month. And what he needed to do now was use the Tianji Record to deduce the weaknesses of those dimensional invaders. Even if the cost was ten years of his lifespan.
